reason: I don't know this brand and it's a camera on my son and a monthly fee on top of the therapy I already pay for. I'd need to see it work on a real bad day before I put that money down.
objection: Will it actually connect and send the SOS when he's wandering off in a store or at the park, or will it fail right when I need it most?
would_change_my_mind: A parent I know and trust, or a support group I'm in, telling me it worked for their wanderer on a real outing.
